theorems.name: Submission.ecf_cone_current
theorems.statement: ∀ (n P : ℕ) (S : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (n + 1)), S.mass ≠ ∞ → IsCompact S.support → S.boundary = 0 → ∃ R : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (n + 2), IsCompact R.support ∧ R.boundary = S ∧ ∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (n + 2), ∃ γ : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (n + 1), R ω = S γ ∧ ∀ x ∈ S.support, ∀ v : Fin (n + 1) → Euclid P, (γ : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (n + 1)) x v = ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, t ^ (n + 1) * (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (n + 2)) (t • x) (Fin.cons x v)
